sources.title: NHS — Migraine
sources.summary: The NHS lists paracetamol and ibuprofen among painkillers used for migraine symptoms, and also lists triptans. Treatment depends on severity and attack frequency.

sources.title: NHS — Sumatriptan
sources.summary: Sumatriptan is used to treat migraine attacks. It is not suitable for everyone and does not prevent attacks from starting.
